sections.overview: Petenia splendida is a Central American freshwater cichlid.
sections.identification: It may reach 50 cm standard length.
sections.habitat: It favours lakes and slow lower river reaches with sand or mud bottoms.
sections.diet: FishBase reports that it feeds on fish.
sections.behavior: Its social and daily activity patterns remain poorly documented.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific reproductive information was not found.
sections.ecology: Its range spans Mexico, Guatemala and Belize; in Mexico it is called Tenguayaca.
sections.conservation: Its 2018 IUCN assessment is Least Concern.
